mission_07: Feature stores provide a centralized system for managing, versioning, and serving features across multiple ML projects. While dedicated feature store platforms like Feast and Tecton exist for production use, the core concepts can be implemented with sklearn pipelines. A feature store registers feature definitions with metadata (name, description, version, owner), stores fitted transformation pipelines, tracks feature lineage (which raw data produces which features), and provides consistent feature retrieval for both training and inference. This ensures that the same feature computation logic is used across all models, eliminating training-serving skew. Feature stores also enable feature reuse across teams, reduce redundant computation, and provide a catalog of available features for discovery. Understanding feature store concepts is essential for building scalable ML infrastructure.
